hypothesis: The fixed ZEC BB40/2.5 policy adds value beyond cash and passive exposure after actual API costs.

calendar.basis: elapsed UTC days after the first eligible prospective open
calendar.extension_after_insufficient_events: No optional extension of the confirmatory endpoint. Report inconclusive and preregister a separate cohort.

data_rules: Use the common calendar from activation; exclude warmup from returns.
Use all ten frozen books; do not select a favorable cost scenario.
Record source gaps, missed-window blocks and outages. Never interpolate or backfill missed decisions.
A blocked cohort remains evidence; replacement has a distinct ID and is never spliced into this cohort.

economic_review.outcome: Paired hourly log changes in estimated net-liquidation equity; terminal net return and maximum drawdown also reported.
economic_review.dependence_method: Paired stationary block bootstrap, mean block length 168 hourly observations, 10000 replicates, seed 1391; resample common time indices across all accounts.
economic_review.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the four primary comparisons, two-sided alpha 0.05. Report effect estimates and intervals even when tests do not reject.
economic_review.limitations: Bootstrap inference is an approximation for dependent, potentially nonstationary returns. One cohort cannot establish universal future profitability. Maker sensitivity is descriptive only.

promotion_requirements: No automatic live promotion or increase in capital.

At the terminal endpoint require a complete valid common calendar, at least 30 completed primary breakout round trips, positive net return, and positive adjusted evidence against every declared comparator. Otherwise report no demonstrated active advantage.
Any candidate must meet the owner-selected drawdown/capital budget; that budget remains unanswered and no live investment allocation is authorized by a paper result.
Independently review event records, accounting, contemporary fees, executable quotes, fill/nonfill behavior and order reconciliation before a separately sized investment decision.
Successful software checks and the tiny live canary prove operational paths only.
current_live_allocation: No new strategy investment capital; completed tiny canary only.
